card.name: Mixed positions mid-sentence, overdose advice
card.fires_on: Small words inside a sentence, such as 'a', 'the' or 'supportive', right after 'contact' or 'standard' in overdose sections. Also scattered words in narrative web text (history, personal remarks).

card.writes: It nudges toward hedging words like 'presumably', 'apparently' and 'seems' and away from first-person words.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in overdose instructions and in loosely told stories, with no single tight theme.
